title: Netherlands Faces Twin Fiscal Crises · 14 Oct
keywords: Netherlands, Dutch budget, social security, welfare state, Box 3, wealth tax, capital gains tax, Eelco Heinen, FNV, CNV, VCP, Dutch politics, EU fiscal policy, disability benefits, unemployment benefits, minority cabinet, Dutch economy, IMF, CPB, Supreme Court, tax reform
notes: The Dutch minority cabinet is navigating a roughly €6 billion hole in its social-security budget after abandoning plans to cut disability and unemployment benefits under pressure from unions and opposition parties. At the same time, a court-mandated overhaul of the country's Box 3 wealth-tax system remains legally and politically unresolved, threatening to delay billions in projected revenue. Together, the two crises pose a fundamental question for the Netherlands: who pays for the welfare state, and how?
